solution.what: Fetched the DECODE record and six images; the f. 376v docket names Lope Hurtado, Rome, December; the cipher shows Lope Hurtado's code groups (ton, zar, xul, rab).

Fetched Bergenroth CSP Spain ii December 1522 (pp. 510-519) and grepped Salazar A. 26: no. 510 = ff. 371-377, Lope Hurtado to the Emperor, 23 Dec 1522, 'Autograph in cipher. Contemporary deciphering.'

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): only Bergenroth's 1866 calendar abstract (csp_510.txt); the contemporary decipherment is at the RAH, not imaged, and the cipher (about 11 pages) was never transcribed (needs physical access / project work)

Looked for a transcription of the cipher (audit section I): none in the folder (csp_510.txt is Bergenroth's English abstract), none on DECODE R9658 (six images, no text). The full-size DECODE images need a login this session does not have, and the RAH digital library answered with a bot check. transcription_missing recorded. By Claude (session of 14 Nov 2026).

outcome.method_basis: The letter is calendared from its contemporary decipherment (RAH Salazar A-26) in Bergenroth, CSP Spain ii no. 510 (1866); the cipher was not re-read here, only identified as Lope Hurtado's 23 Dec 1522 despatch from the docket, the folios and his code groups.

texts.transcription_missing: The cipher of RAH 9/26 (Salazar A-26) ff. 371r-375v, about eleven written pages in Lope Hurtado's 1522 system, was never transcribed: the entry was closed on the CSP Spain abstract. No transcription is on DECODE R9658 (six images, no text file). DECODE serves full-size images only to a logged-in user (checked 14 Nov 2026: the public record page lists thumbnails, the file server answers 'Insufficient permissions'), and this session has no login; the RAH digital library (bibliotecadigital.rah.es) answered with a bot check ('Making sure you're not a bot') on 14 Nov 2026. Unblocks it: the DECODE images (login, or img/ in the main checkout) or the RAH scans through a browser; the sibling folder ../lopehurtado/ has the system's code groups to check a transcription by decoding.
texts.label: R9658, RAH 9/26 ff. 371-376, Lope Hurtado de Mendoza, Rome, 23 Dec 1522 (CSP Spain ii no. 510, calendared from the contemporary decipherment)
texts.summary: Lope Hurtado de Mendoza to Charles V from Rome: the Pope will not enter a league with the Emperor and the King of England while he hopes for a general peace; the Bishop of Veroli is in Rome with the Swiss ambassadors, who ask 36,000 ducats, to be shared by the Apostolic See, the Emperor and the Duke of Milan. Bergenroth (1866) calendared it from the contemporary decipherment, which is not imaged on DECODE.
